description: This file defines an API client for frontend communication with a backend service, including functions for GET, POST, DELETE, PATCH requests, and specific operations for work items and comments, with authentication headers and localStorage-based user info.

methods.name: withAuthHeaders(extra = {})
methods.description: Helper to build request headers including Authorization if token exists.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request, returns parsed JSON or throws error.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a POST request with JSON body, returns parsed JSON or throws error.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Performs a GET request with query parameters, returns parsed JSON or throws error.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request with JSON body, returns parsed JSON or throws error.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a new comment to a work item, sourcing author_id from localStorage if not provided.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches list of work items, optionally filtered by projectId.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item with provided details.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specified work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Builds full API URL from a path.
